title: RAW_UNSCREENED: f17r.5 Teilfolge als Liste oder Relation
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: cthy chor shor cphor cphaldy dair cthey qody can be a coordinated part inventory or a directed multi-step record; the distinction rests on later written scope.

design.scope_description: Exact f17r.5 and f29v.1 part-rich lines plus cached whole-form controls from GDT768/GDT809.
design.mechanism: List semantics groups several named items under one record; relational semantics links each item to a successive operation/state.
design.unit: The eight complete forms on f17r.5 and their exact recurrences.
design.contrast: Coordinated inventory versus directed process relation.
design.prediction: List reading predicts recurring members with parallel modifier/value frames; relation reading predicts ordered successor/output links and a final closure after the chain.
concrete_observations: GDT809 gives exact f17r.5 cthy chor shor cphor cphaldy dair cthey qody in all readers.
GDT809/GDT768 also expose f29v.1 shor and cthy in another part-rich line.
linked_consequences: A list should preserve item order while allowing independent descriptors.
A relation chain should require each claimed output or operation to be written and available to the next step.
design.nearest_rival: A recipe/assembly chain whose forms are not coordinated list members.
design.distinguishing_observation: Trace exact whole-form recurrences: a list wins only with parallel member frames; a chain wins only with written successor/output bindings across at least two loci.
assumption_costs: later cofields can be compared without image access
design.strongest_likely_failure: Both models can preserve the same order and all unknown forms, with no written relation or closure marker.
